title: Juice N Power Bar Salts Pineapple Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Pineapple Ice from the JNP Bar Salts collection offers a deeply exotic and intensely refreshing tropical fruit profile. The distinct, mouth-watering tang and syrupy sweetness of fresh Pineapple create a bright and sunny foundation. This vivid fruit character is perfectly complemented by a smooth layer of crisp Ice, ensuring a clean and thoroughly revitalising experience that excels as an all-day option. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid nicotine relief and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation. The balanced 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal combination of clear, intense flavour and discreet vapour production. These extra-concentrated e-liquids are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. Formulated by the UK brand Juice N Power, the JNP Bar Salts collection takes inspiration from popular bar-style blends to deliver intense, long-lasting flavour in a versatile 10ml format. Offering a comprehensive range of fruit, soda, and confectionery profiles alongside unique mixes, there is a dependable option for every preference. Beyond the exotic chill of Pineapple Ice, vapers can explore other compelling profiles such as the rich Mixed Berries or the sharp Blue Sour Raspberry.
